Learning Acceleration: The 571 breakthrough moments (243 major) indicate rapid strategy refinement. "metta": { "command": "uv", "args": [ "run", "--project", "/Users/zfogg/src/github.com/metta-ai/metta", "python", "-m", "mcp_server.server" ], "env": { "AWS_PROFILE": "softmax", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": null, "METTA_MCP_BACKEND_URL": "http://localhost:8000", // or "METTA_MCP_BACKEND_URL": "https://api.observatory.softmax-research.net" }, "transport": "stdio" }, "metta-observatory": { "command": "uv", "args": [ "run", "--project", "/Users/zfogg/src/github.com/metta-ai/metta/app_backend", "python", "-m", "metta.app_backend.mcp_stdio_server" ], "env": { "FASTMCP_EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_NEW_OPENAPI_PARSER": "true", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": null, "AWS_PROFILE": "softmax" }, "transport": "stdio" } # ... ``` ## Generated: This PR adds Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support to the Metta project, enabling external tools and AI assistants to interact with the codebase, training infrastructure, and evaluation systems through a standardized interface. What's Changed MCP Server Implementation - New MCP server module (mcp_server/) with comprehensive tool implementations for: - Training management (start, stop, monitor training runs) - Policy evaluation and comparison - Environment inspection and configuration - Log analysis and metrics retrieval - File operations with project-aware path handling Widget and Client Improvements - Refactored scorecard client (app_backend/clients/scorecard_client.py): - Added get_scorecard_data() method for unified data fetching - Improved error handling with ignore_missing_policies parameter - Better type hints and documentation - Updated scorecard widget (scorecard_widget/ScorecardWidget.py): - Simplified data fetching logic by delegating to the client - Added support for ignoring missing policies during evaluation - Improved integration with the policy selector widget Policy Selector Integration - Enhanced policy selector example (experiments/marimo/policy-selector-example.py): - Better widget synchronization and data flow - Cleaner separation of concerns between widgets Key Features MCP Server Capabilities As you work with him, Claude (and Cursor) can now have tools like: - train_agent: Start training with customizable parameters - analyze_replay: Use Claude's API to analyze a replay file to learn any insights - eval_policy: Run evaluations on trained policies - get_training_status: Monitor active training runs - get_logs: Retrieve training/evaluation logs - list_policies: Browse available policies - compare_policies: Generate comparative analysis - describe_environment: Inspect environment configurations - run_sim: Execute simulations with specific policies Improvements to Existing Components - More robust error handling in scorecard data fetching - Better support for standalone (run-free) policies - Improved metric selection and validation - Enhanced type safety across the codebase Testing - MCP server tested with Claude Desktop and other MCP-compatible clients like Claude Code and Gemini CLI - Widget and backend_app API improvements validated through the Marimo notebooks - Backwards compatibility maintained for existing scorecard usage [Asana Task](https://app.asana.com/1/1209016784099267/project/1210348820405981/task/1211070156596892)
